docs.summary: A texture's in-progress sprite settings, shared between the texture inspector and the Sprite Editor.
The GUID of the texture this target edits.
The in-memory sprite settings being edited.

Set when [`Settings`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.RagdollBuilder.Settings) has been edited and not yet folded back into the texture's import-settings compound. The compound is what the inspector diffs to decide whether anything needs applying, so this only marks "needs re-serializing", not "needs saving".

True when the texture's existing sprite settings could not be read. [`Settings`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.RagdollBuilder.Settings) is then defaults that do not describe what is on disk, so saving would destroy the real slicing.
